name: audit_agent
description: Run a Heron audit against a target agent endpoint. Interrogates the agent, analyzes the transcript, maps findings to compliance frameworks, and returns a markdown audit report plus a report id you can pass to get_report or compare_reports.

target_endpoint.description: URL of the target agent (OpenAI-compatible chat API).

name: get_report
description: Retrieve a previously-generated Heron audit report by its id.

report_id.description: The report id returned by a prior audit_agent call.

name: compare_reports
description: Compare two Heron audit reports by id and return a markdown diff highlighting what was resolved, what changed, and what was added between the two audits.
